text:
maria: heads-up — discovered a confusing gap between the SDKs re env var precedence for API keys. python prefers REDWOOD_API_KEY, js prefers RW_API_KEY, and our sample app uses RW_TOKEN. :grimacing:
kevin: omg that's... rough. can you paste the sample app README snippet?
maria: sure —
```
ENV VARS:\n  REDWOOD_API_KEY - primary API key
  RW_ORG - org id
  RW_PROJECT - project id
```
kevin: sample app README != SDK defaults. that's the core issue. devs copy the readme and then wonder why auth fails. :facepalm:
sam: quick question — do we intentionally support both org- and project-scoped keys? libs behave differently on fallback. python will try project -> org -> account, js tries org->project.
maria: it's not intentional, it's historical. we added project-scoped keys later and never aligned SDK behavior.
julie: can we standardize to: explicit project key first, then org, then account-level? that matches RBAC flows.
kevin: +1 for project-first. also propose env var canonical names: REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_SCOPE (values: project:<id> or org:<id>) so sample apps don't introduce variants.
sam: practical question — how to handle rotation? ops want short-lived keys for CI. current SDK caches auth in memory and doesn't refresh transparently. leads to 401s mid-run.
maria: we saw that in the nightly e2e — job fails after token expiry, no automatic refresh path.
kevin: sdk fix idea: accept a credential provider callback (sync/async) like AWS SDK. if provided, call it on 401 and retry once. that keeps default simple but enables rotation for prod.
julie: love the provider approach. add a small helper in sample apps to wire GCP/Azure secret versions to the provider.
kevin: also add a CLI lint that warns when sample app env vars don't match SDK defaults (devex task). quick grep during release pipeline.
cli-bot: new issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/478 — align env var names + add credential-provider pattern. (created by cli-bot)
maria: for immediate triage: i'll open a tiny PR to the python SDK to read both REDWOOD_API_KEY and RW_API_KEY (fallback) and log a deprecation warning when RW_API_KEY is present. then we can update sample apps to canonical names.
sam: can we also add a short doc in devportal: "Auth env var precedence" with a table + example commands? new hires keep tripping over this.
julie: i'll draft that doc and a migration guide with sed commands to update env files.
kevin: one more: we need consistent retry semantics across SDKs on 401+refresh. record as part of SDK parity checklist.
maria: thanks — i'll file parity checklist entries and link the PRs. for transparency, pinging @devex: please weigh in on naming and provider API shape. :eyes:
kevin: noted. next steps: maria PR for fallback+deprecation, julie write doc, sam design provider callback API, and I'll add CLI lint issue.
maria: assigning tasks and will update the thread once PR is up. thanks team! :thumbsup:
